## 2. Shared Conventions

### Release 0.45.5 credit input semantics

Credit creation explicitly using `balance_input_mode=available_credit` subtracts `credit_limit` from supplied bank-available balance to store canonical signed net balance. Omitted/legacy mode preserves net semantics. With limit 300000 and available 100000, debt is 200000 and own funds zero. Existing account balances are not automatically migrated; correction still requires a separate confirmation. Credit interest is a percentage rate with decimal precision and preview based on actual debt. Transfers and FX confirmation rules are unchanged. Local browser fixtures are not authenticated production financial acceptance.
